profile.label: PROFILE
profile.text: Senior Service Designer & CX Strategist with 5+ years at AKQA shaping the future of customer experience, service design, and product innovation for high-profile brands across banking, superannuation, retail, and government. Expert at leading cross-functional teams through complex initiatives, translating deep customer insights into evidence-based strategies and service solutions that enhance experiences, strengthen loyalty, and drive measurable business growth.

experience.title: Senior Service Designer & CX Strategist
experience.description: Leading end-to-end service design engagements for high-profile brands across banking, superannuation, retail, and government. Translating deep customer insights into evidence-based strategies and service solutions.
highlights: Delivered transformational service design outcomes for a major Australian bank
Led 3-year CX digital transformation roadmap for a global fast food chain
Designed journey maps and service blueprints for a luxury outdoor architecture brand
Transformed the Forms & Guides experience for a federal government agency
Facilitated co-design workshops and design sprints across cross-functional client teams

experience.title: Service Designer
experience.description: Mapped complex backstage processes and compliance workflows within a heavily regulated environment to identify operational bottlenecks and improve taxpayer experiences.
highlights: Diagnosed operational challenges across compliance-heavy workflows
Conducted ethnographic research and synthesised findings into actionable opportunities
Built capability across multidisciplinary teams through shared methods and service standards

experience.title: Service Designer
experience.description: Partnered with clients to design and validate early-stage service concepts, synthesise research into compelling narratives, and build capability across government teams.
highlights: Designed and executed structured concept testing and low-fidelity prototyping with customers
Synthesised qualitative research into journey maps and service narratives for diverse stakeholders
Facilitated service design training and co-creation workshops for large state government cohorts
